description:
Create a UML Component Diagram in EdrawMax representing an e-commerce microservices architecture. 

Starting from the Home screen, create a new 'UML Component' diagram. 

Model the following 6 components (use the standard UML component shape):
1. API Gateway
2. User Service
3. Product Catalog Service
4. Order Service
5. Payment Service
6. Notification Service

Define the following dependency relationships (use dashed arrows/dependency lines):
- API Gateway depends on User Service, Product Catalog Service, and Order Service
- Order Service depends on Payment Service, Product Catalog Service, and Notification Service

Add appropriate interface symbols (lollipop/socket notation or labeled ports) to show that services provide APIs and require data access. 

Add a title text 'E-Commerce Microservices Component Diagram' at the top.

Save the editable diagram as '/home/ga/Documents/ecommerce_component_diagram.eddx' and export a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/ecommerce_component_diagram.png'.

If any 'Temporary Files' or 'Account Login' dialogs appear at startup, dismiss them.
